object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Export a document with a draw.io figure and a plain SVG figure through a figure program stand-in that produces figure PDFs; then, with the PDF program present, a figure far larger than the page. Expected: the figure program is given the draw.io figure as it is and the plain SVG wrapped as a picture of its own size; each drawn figure is placed in the PDF and none is reported as not drawn; the real PDF is produced.
